title: unmeasured
responsibility: Records explicit unavailable latency and memory entries when no benchmark observed a unit.

inputs.name: unmeasured.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier attached to each measurement when recording this unit's unmeasured verification evidence. The function copies it unchanged and does not check registration or source ownership.

inputs.name: unmeasured.testedRevision
inputs.description: Commit revision attached to each measurement so the verification evidence identifies what was tested. The function copies it unchanged and does not validate its format.

outputs.name: unmeasured
outputs.description: Returns two measurements for warm latency and memory, each with a null value and a fixed unavailable reason. The method is 'Not measured.', workload and profile are null, and artifacts is empty, so no benchmark numbers or evidence artifacts are supplied.

examples.unavailable: No benchmark measured this unit in this verification.
No benchmark measured this unit, and in-process memory cannot be attributed to it.
